mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, approver_id, approver_name, action, reason, approval_level, timestamp FROM approval_record WHERE request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY approval_level ASC, timestamp DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record (id, request_id, approver_id, approver_name, action, reason, approval_level, timestamp) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, #{approverId}, #{approverName}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{approvalLevel}, #{timestamp})
